samples.name: Memory Toolkit 4.0.5
evidence: 37-member OpenClaw memory-management skill; SQLite FTS5/vector search, extraction, arbitration and backup-protected maintenance.

Ollama HTTP requests and configured API-key reads support the advertised inference workflow. Trace extraction and ontology cloud backfill require TRACE_LLM_ALLOW_CLOUD; TRACE_LLM_LOCAL_ONLY overrides consent.
Indexing rejects symlinks and sensitive paths. Transcript adapter snapshots SQLite and redacts common secret formats. No concealed execution or theft chain found.

samples.name: @copilot-mcp/apex 1.0.18
evidence: Five-member npm archive, postinstall node install.cjs, source manifest version 1.0.18.
Installer fetches platform assets from Apex-Foundation/copilot v1.0.0, separate from the declared copilot-mcp source. Main download SHA256 check fails open if checksum download fails.
macOS branch stages apex-helper-darwin under ~/.apex, chmods 0755, spawnSync executes the same path and then unlinkSync removes it. The helper is not covered by the main binary checksum.
Launcher executes the installed program; --mcp-stdio resolves or fetches @apexfdn/copilot-mcp via npx.

Known helper-dropper source fingerprint corroborated against independent published analysis. No downstream credential-theft or persistence code is present in this tarball; live helper retrieval returned HTTP 404.

changes: Retired hostile portal/token and installation-documentation co-occurrences; these establish neither malware identity nor exfiltration.

Moved package references to os/application/target and PAT-name references to os/env/secret-name. Portal reference is an HTTP service observation. C2-domain identity moved with the dropper family; no objective infers a connection from it.

Moved the Apex family from legacy malware/supply-chain to malware/dropper. Hostile rules require staged execution/cleanup, HTTP streaming and a release URL; family repository/helper literals are alternatives. Bundle rule additionally requires a declared Node postinstall. No conviction requires an outer archive or sidecar filename.
WebSocket compatibility composite requires a websockets import as well as connect(); removed standalone unqualified-call misattribution.
Moved API chat/generate path from local-LLM inference to generic URL path; added hosted Ollama literal observation excluding Python docstrings.
Moved generic CLI output flags from containers to process arguments and required token boundaries; -only, -openclaw.json and --out are negative controls.

Moved TimeoutExpired to error-handling, database extension loading to dylib/load/runtime, Python -c to process/create/eval and npx spawn target to os/application/target. Execution APIs retain their independent notable traits.
Moved generic model/language/output wording to llm/agent. A source-generation directive now requires a prompt/instruction explicitly requesting code or a program.

Validation exposed Base64 leaf at 103 rules. Audited all members; relocated encoded PHP name to file/encoding, its callback profile to metaprogramming/reflection, and a native decode-error diagnostic to error-handling. The leaf now holds 100 actual decoding observations. Exact callers updated; broad Base64 selectors now exclude mere encoded-byte presence and diagnostics.
mapping_review: Neutral observations do not inherit attacker T1195.002/T1041 mappings. New family detections make only a dropper-identity claim; no exfiltration, stealer, persistence or escalation mapping is added.
reference_review: Exact YAML consumers updated. The existing pinned-skill-tools JSON fixture reference to TimeoutExpired was migrated with the rule; all other external JSON references were checked. Ancestor selectors audited: removal of bare connect() from WebSocket selection and non-source prose from code-generation selection is intentional. Generic subprocess APIs remain in place; library loading no longer contributes a process-creation observation.

validation.notes: Source scripts were inspected statically; no package or downloaded code was run. rizin confirmed the outer tarball has no executable-binary format. binwalk was unavailable.
